items.title: Barriers and Facilitators to Cardiac Rehabilitation Adherence in Post-PCI Patients: A Qualitative Study From an Implementation Science Perspective.
items.abstract: To explore barriers and facilitators influencing adherence to cardiac rehabilitation among patients after percutaneous coronary intervention from patient and healthcare-professional perspectives. A descriptive qualitative study guided by the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research. Purposive sampling recruited 21 patients receiving Phase II cardiac rehabilitation and 15 healthcare professionals from two tertiary hospitals in Lishui, China. Face-to-face semi-structured interviews were conducted from May to June 2025. Data were analysed using a primarily deductive thematic analysis guided by the framework. Five themes and 11 subthemes were identified across innovation characteristics, inner setting, outer setting, individual characteristics and implementation process. Adherence was influenced by perceived evidence strength and cost; implementation climate, communication and resources; family and policy support; self-efficacy, health-behaviour change and fear of physical exertion; and geographical and scheduling barriers. Adherence after percutaneous coronary intervention reflected interacting patient, family, professional, organisational and health-system determinants. Contrasting rehabilitation infrastructure at the two hospitals helped explain differences in multidisciplinary support and continuity of care. Nurses can provide consistent risk communication, assess fear of physical exertion, involve families in education, coordinate referral and telephone follow-up, and escalate unmet nutritional, psychological and exercise-rehabilitation needs. This study addresses persistent underuse of Phase II cardiac rehabilitation. It shows that non-adherence cannot be attributed to patients alone and identifies organisation- and nursing-sensitive determinants. Findings can inform hospital services caring for patients after percutaneous coronary intervention where rehabilitation capacity is uneven. The study is reported according to the Consolidated Criteria for Reporting Qualitative Research. Patients and healthcare professionals contributed interview data and participated in member checking; they were not involved in the initial study design.

items.title: Prognostic Value of Forearm Circumference in Older Patients With Heart Failure.
items.abstract: In older patients with heart failure, lower muscle mass is associated with worse prognosis, making its assessment clinically important. However, assessment of muscle mass is not routinely feasible in all clinical settings because it often requires specialized equipment. Therefore, we aimed to examine whether forearm circumference, an easily obtainable anthropometric surrogate of muscle mass, is associated with 2-year all-cause mortality. We performed a post hoc analysis of the prospective multicenter FRAGILE-HF cohort, which enrolled consecutive patients aged ≥ 65 years hospitalized with heart failure. Forearm circumference was measured at discharge at the point of maximal circumference on each forearm, and the larger value from either side was used. Forearm circumference was stratified by sex into quartiles, and 2-year all-cause mortality after discharge was evaluated using Cox proportional hazards models. Of 1332 enrolled patients, 1281 were analyzed (median [interquartile range] age 81 years [74-86 years], 57.2% men). Median forearm circumference was 22.8 cm (21.5-24.2 cm) in men and 20.3 cm (18.9-22.0 cm) in women. Using Quartile 1 as the reference group, higher forearm circumference was associated with lower mortality in adjusted Cox proportional hazards models (hazard ratio 0.59 [95% CI 0.42-0.82] for Quartile 2, 0.52 [0.36-0.74] for Quartile 3, and 0.45 [0.30-0.68] for Quartile 4). Forearm circumference was inversely associated with 2-year all-cause mortality in older patients with heart failure and may provide a practical option for risk stratification. UMIN-CTR: UMIN000023929.

items.title: Comparative Prognostic Value of Mayo 2012 and European-Modified Mayo 2004 Staging Systems in Systemic AL Amyloidosis With Discordant Risk Classification.
items.abstract: The Mayo 2012 and European-modified Mayo 2004 (European-modified) staging systems are widely used in systemic light-chain (AL) amyloidosis, but their comparative prognostic performance in patients with discordant stage classifications remains unclear. We retrospectively analyzed 177 patients with systemic AL amyloidosis treated with first-line bortezomib-based therapy between January 2020 and March 2025. Patients were classified using both staging systems, and discordance was assessed using predefined stage mapping. Overall survival (OS) was evaluated using Kaplan-Meier analysis, time-dependent receiver operating characteristic curves, concordance indices, and Cox regression. Hematologic and organ responses were assessed as exploratory outcomes. Discordant stage classifications were identified in 83 patients (46.9%). In this subgroup, the European-modified system demonstrated significant separation of OS curves across stages (log-rank p = 0.0008), identifying Stage IIIB as a particularly high-risk group with a median OS of 2.9 months. The Mayo 2012 system also significantly stratified OS. At 6 months, the European-modified system showed a numerically higher time-dependent AUC than the Mayo 2012 system (0.759 vs. 0.614), although the difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.092). Similar nonsignificant differences were observed at 12 and 24 months, and differences in Harrell's and Uno's C-indices were also not statistically significant. Exploratory treatment response analyses were limited by potential selection bias and nonuniform response assessment. Among patients with discordant stage classifications, the European-modified system demonstrated significant OS stratification and identified patients at particularly high risk of early mortality. Although it showed numerically higher prognostic discrimination than the Mayo 2012 system, the differences were not statistically significant. These findings suggest potential clinical utility for early risk stratification but require validation in larger independent cohorts.

items.title: [Guideline for the diagnosis, treatment and management of drug-induced kidney injury (2026)].
items.abstract: Drug-induced kidney injury (DIKI) has a high incidence and increases the risk of chronic kidney disease and mortality. Although DIKI poses a serious threat to public health in China, the condition is preventable and controllable. To enhance awareness and standardize protocols for risk screening, early identification, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment, the Chinese Society of Clinical Pharmacy and the Chinese Society of Renal Diseases convened a multidisciplinary panel of experts to establish an editorial committee responsible for developing the Guideline for the Diagnosis, Treatment, and Management of Drug-Induced Kidney Injury. Based on a systematic search and evaluation of national and international guidelines, consensus statements, and research evidence, and taking into account China's tiered healthcare delivery framework and clinical practice experience, the committee developed this guideline through rigorous discussion and extensive consultation with specialists in pharmacy, nephrology, cardiology, and related fields. The guideline addresses the definition and classification of DIKI, common causative drugs, risk factors, diagnosis and severity assessment, prevention, treatment, prognosis, and follow-up management. It also establishes actionable risk identification and prevention workflows, monitoring frequencies, referral criteria, and key points for patient education suitable for implementation in primary care settings. Finally, the guideline provides a reference for the standardized management of DIKI among clinicians, pharmacists, nurses, technicians, and other relevant personnel, thereby improving the standard of DIKI management in China. 药物性肾损伤（DIKI）发病率高，可增加慢性肾脏病和死亡风险，严重危害我国居民健康，但可防可控。为提高对DIKI的认知，规范其风险筛查、早期识别、诊断与防治流程，中华医学会临床药学分会及中华医学会肾脏病学分会组织多学科专家，成立了《药物性肾损伤诊疗与管理指南（2026）》编写委员会。编写委员会在系统检索和评价国内外相关指南、共识及研究证据的基础上，结合我国医疗机构分级诊疗现状和临床实践经验，经充分讨论，并广泛征求药学、肾脏病学、心血管病学等各领域专家意见后，制定本指南。本指南重点明确了DIKI的定义及分型、常见致病药物、危险因素、诊断与严重程度评估、预防、治疗、预后及随访管理等内容，同时制定了适用于基层医疗机构的风险识别与预防流程、监测频率、转诊标准及患者宣教要点，旨在为临床医、药、护、技等人员提供DIKI规范化管理的参考，全面提升我国DIKI管理水平。.

items.title: MAIT cells in tumor contexts: Functional diversity and regulatory hierarchies.
items.abstract: Mucosal associated invariant T (MAIT) cells are a unique subset of innate T lymphocytes that play a critical role in the host's defense against bacterial and viral pathogens. However, its function in the tumor microenvironment (TME) remains controversial. This review systematically explores the dual role of MAIT cells in tumor immunity by integrating existing literature evidence, and proposes a three-level causal hierarchy that determines the functional fate of MAIT cells. In order to solve the prognostic paradox across cancer types, we introduced the barrier and systemic tumor classification criteria. Based on the above mechanisms, we explored clinical translation pathways such as MR1 targeted intervention, iPSC derived reMAIT cells, and CAR-MAIT engineering. Future research should utilize spatial omics and dynamic tracking techniques to achieve a shift from descriptive observations to precise predictive healthcare driven by biomarkers.

items.title: [Analysis of influenza vaccination status and influencing factors among vaccination healthcare workers in Bijie City, 2025].
items.abstract: During the 2024-2025 influenza season, the influenza vaccination rate among 1 647 immunization healthcare workers in Bijie City, Guizhou Province, was 36.55% ( n =602), and the recommendation rate was 63.33% ( n =1 043). Multivariate logistic regression analysis, using as references those with urban residence, no children under 6 years of age living in the same household, never participating in influenza-related health education, self-paid vaccination, no influenza vaccination in the previous 5 years, and a knowledge score ≤5, showed that rural residence [ OR (95% CI ): 0.60 (0.42-0.85)] and having one child under 6 years old in the household [ OR (95% CI ):0.66 (0.50-0.89)] were associated with lower vaccination rates. In contrast, frequent participation in health education [ OR (95% CI ):4.01 (1.43-11.23)], always participation [ OR (95% CI ): 6.36(2.26-17.95)], vaccination costs covered by medical insurance [ OR (95% CI ):1.87 (1.19-2.93)], having received influenza vaccine in the past 5 years [ OR (95% CI ): 22.56(14.50-35.11)], and a knowledge score >5 [ OR (95% CI ):1.30(1.01-1.66)] were all significantly associated with higher vaccination rates. 2024—2025年流感流行季贵州毕节市1 647名预防接种医务工作者流感疫苗接种率为36.55%（602名），推荐率为63.33%（1 043名）。多因素logistic回归模型分析显示：分别以居住地区为城市中心、同住6岁以下儿童数为0、从不参加流感及流感疫苗宣传宣教、接种费用为自费、既往5年无流感疫苗接种史、流感及流感疫苗知识得分≤5为参照：居住地区为农村［ OR （95% CI ）：0.60（0.42~0.85）］、同住6岁以下儿童数为1的对象流感疫苗接种率较低［ OR （95% CI ）：0.66（0.50~0.89）］；经常或总是参加流感及流感疫苗宣传宣教［ OR （95% CI ）值分别为4.01（1.43~11.23）、6.36（2.26~17.95）］、接种费用医保支付［ OR （95% CI ）：1.87（1.19~2.93）］、既往5年有流感疫苗接种史［ OR （95% CI ）：22.56（14.50~35.11）］、流感及流感疫苗得分>5［ OR （95% CI ）：1.30（1.01~1.66）］的对象流感疫苗接种率更高。.

items.title: [Health economic evaluation of the influenza vaccination program for the elderly in Zhejiang Province].
items.abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the cost-effectiveness of the seasonal influenza vaccination program for adults aged ≥60 years in Zhejiang Province, China, during the 2024-2025 influenza season from a societal perspective. The intervention strategy referred to the administration of one dose of trivalent inactivated influenza vaccine, while the control strategy assumed no influenza vaccination. Evaluation indicators included incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER), incremental net monetary benefit (INMB) and benefit-cost ratio (B/C). With an ICER 0, or B/C ratio >1, the intervention strategy was considered cost-effective. Results showed that the intervention strategy with a 35% vaccination coverage rate was estimated to reduce influenza cases by 15.75% compared with the control strategy, yielding an incremental gain of 6 462 QALYs. The corresponding ICER, INMB and B/C were 4 751 CNY/QALY, 56.36 CNY and 4.93, respectively. 基于全社会角度评价2024—2025流行季浙江省≥60岁老年人流感疫苗接种项目的成本效果。干预策略为免费为老年人接种1剂三价灭活流感疫苗，对照策略为完全不接种流感疫苗。评价指标包括增量成本-效果比（ICER）、增量净货币效益（INMB）和效益-成本比（B/C），ICER低于当地1倍人均GDP、INMB>0或B/C>1认为干预策略具有经济性。结果显示：与对照策略相比，干预策略35%接种率的基础情形可减少15.75%的老年人罹患流感，相应增加的健康效用为6 462个QALYs，实施干预策略的ICER为4 751 元/QALY、INMB为56.36元、B/C为4.93。.

items.title: [Investigation and analysis of knowledge acquisition and trust in information channels regarding non-national immunization program vaccines among adults in three provinces and one municipality in China].
items.abstract: In November 2024, 4 105 adults were selected from 120 vaccination clinics in 30 counties, county-level cities, or districts in Shandong province, Anhui province, Gansu province, and Shanghai Municipality (three provinces and one municipality in China). Data were collected using anonymous online questionnaires administered via Wenjuanxing and paper questionnaires completed with assistance from survey staff. The survey assessed the importance of and trust in information channels for non-national immunization program (non-NIP) vaccines and related knowledge needs. The Friedman rank sum test was used to compare importance rankings and trust scores across channels and knowledge-need scores across items. Principal component analysis was performed to explore the underlying structure of trust in information channels. The three highest composite importance scores were for information provided by vaccination clinic staff (6.09), official media reports (3.27), and advice from hospital physicians (3.09). The three highest composite trust scores were for information provided by vaccination clinic staff (3.95), advice from hospital physicians (3.89), and official media reports (3.34). The Friedman rank sum test showed that differences in composite importance scores across information channels ( χ 2 =3 433.905, P χ 2 =8 450.161, P χ 2 =629.160, P <0.001) were all statistically significant. Scores for knowledge needs regarding vaccination safety (3.98) and effectiveness (3.91) were relatively high. Principal component analysis identified four components: official-channel reporting, recommendations from healthcare professionals, media-channel reporting, and recommendations through interpersonal networks. These components together explained 88.12% of the total variance. In conclusion, health education should prioritize effective communication through healthcare professionals and official channels, strengthen the verification of unofficial reports, and support informed decisions about non-NIP vaccination. 于2024年11月，从我国山东省、安徽省、甘肃省和上海市（三省一市）30个县（市、区）的120家预防接种门诊抽取4 105名成人作为研究对象，通过问卷星线上匿名填报与调查员辅助填写纸质问卷相结合的方式调查非免疫规划疫苗信息获取渠道的重要性和信任程度及知识需求，采用Friedman秩和检验分别比较各渠道的重要性排序、信任评分及各项知识需求评分，并采用主成分分析探讨渠道信任的潜在结构。结果显示，获取渠道的重要性综合得分前3位为预防接种门诊工作人员介绍（6.09分）、官方媒体报道（3.27分）和医院医生建议（3.09分）；信任程度综合得分前3位为预防接种门诊工作人员介绍（3.95分）、医院医生建议（3.89分）和官方媒体报道（3.34分），Friedman秩和检验显示，信息获取渠道的重要性综合得分（ χ ²=3 433.905， P χ ²=8 450.161， P χ ²=629.160， P <0.001）的差异均有统计学意义。知识需求中接种安全性（3.98分）和接种效果（3.91分）得分较高。主成分分析提取出4个主成分，分别为官方渠道报道、专业医疗人员推荐、媒体渠道报告和人际网络推荐，累计方差贡献率为88.12%。综上，健康教育应优先增强专业医疗与官方渠道的传播效果，并加强对非官方报道的核查，为非免疫规划疫苗预防接种提供信息支持。.

items.title: [Awareness, attitudes, and associated factors towards non-national immunization program vaccines among adults in three provinces and one municipality in China].
items.abstract: Objective: To assess knowledge of and attitudes toward non-national immunization program (non-NIP) vaccines among adults in Shandong Province, Anhui Province, Gansu Province, and Shanghai Municipality (three provinces and one municipality) in China, and to identify associated factors. Methods: In November 2024, 120 vaccination clinics were selected from 30 counties, county-level cities, or districts across the four study areas. A questionnaire survey was conducted among permanent residents aged ≥18 years within the clinics' catchment areas. Data on demographic characteristics, vaccine knowledge, vaccination attitudes, and the most trusted source of vaccine information were collected. Multivariable linear regression analyses were used to examine associated factors. Results: A total of 4 105 valid questionnaires were obtained. The median ( Q 1 , Q 3 ) awareness score was 2 (1, 2) for the influenza vaccine; 1 (1, 2) for the pneumococcal vaccine, live attenuated varicella vaccine, human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine, and inactivated enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccine; and 1 (0, 2) for the meningococcal polysaccharide vaccine against serogroups A, C, Y, and W135 (MPV-ACYW135), herpes zoster vaccine, rotavirus vaccine, combined adsorbed diphtheria, tetanus, acellular pertussis, inactivated poliomyelitis, and Haemophilus influenzae type b vaccine (DTaP-IPV/Hib), and Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) conjugate vaccine. Mean self-rated core knowledge scores for the 10 vaccines ranged from 3.01 to 3.26. Multivariable linear regression analyses showed that respondents living in township administrative centers had an overall awareness score 0.066 points higher than those living in urban communities ( P =0.012). Compared with respondents who identified vaccination clinic staff as their most trusted source of vaccine information, those who trusted online influencers or blogs by public figures had an overall awareness score 0.512 points higher ( P =0.007), whereas those who trusted official reports in online or print media, advice from relatives or friends, advice from hospital physicians, or unofficial online or other media reports had scores 0.180, 0.466, 0.255, and 0.353 points lower, respectively (all P P =0.045). Compared with healthcare workers, non-healthcare workers, retirees, and respondents in other occupational categories had overall self-rated core knowledge scores 0.209, 0.254, and 0.269 points lower, respectively ( P P =0.008, and P =0.001, respectively). Compared with respondents who identified vaccination clinic staff as their most trusted source of vaccine information, those who trusted online influencers or blogs by public figures had an overall self-rated core knowledge score 0.936 points higher ( P =0.017), whereas those who trusted official reports in online or print media, advice from relatives or friends, advice from hospital physicians, or unofficial online or other media reports had scores 0.213, 0.675, 0.415, and 0.586 points lower, respectively ( P =0.004, P P P =0.001, respectively). Regarding vaccination attitudes, respondents generally endorsed selecting self-paid vaccines for children according to disease severity, vaccinating children with self-paid vaccines against important diseases whenever possible, and accepting mild postvaccination reactions (mean item scores, 3.57-3.73). However, concerns or limited understanding remained regarding limiting self-paid vaccination, choosing self-paid vaccines that could replace vaccines provided free of charge, and coadministration of multiple self-paid vaccines (mean item scores, 2.76-3.03). Conclusion: Adults surveyed in the three provinces and one municipality have low self-reported awareness of non-NIP vaccines. Most recognize their preventive value, but some remain concerned about vaccination risks and coadministration of multiple vaccines. Residential setting and the most trusted source of vaccine information are associated with overall awareness scores, whereas educational attainment, occupation, and the most trusted source of vaccine information are associated with overall self-rated core knowledge scores. 目的： 分析我国山东省、安徽省、甘肃省和上海市（三省一市）成人对非免疫规划疫苗的认知水平、接种态度及相关因素。 方法： 2024年11月，选取三省一市的30 个县（市、区）的120 家接种单位，对辖区18 岁以上常住居民开展问卷调查，收集人口学特征、疫苗认知、接种态度及获取信息的信任渠道等数据，采用多元线性回归分析相关因素。 结果： 共回收有效问卷4 105 份。成人对流感疫苗知晓情况得分为2（1，2）分；肺炎球菌疫苗、水痘减毒活疫苗、人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）疫苗和肠道病毒71型（EV71）灭活疫苗均为1（1，2）分；ACYW135群脑膜炎球菌多糖疫苗（MPV-ACYW135）、带状疱疹疫苗、轮状病毒疫苗、吸附无细胞百白破灭活脊髓灰质炎和b型流感嗜血杆菌联合疫苗（DTaP-IPV/Hib）和b型流感嗜血杆菌（Hib）结合疫苗均为1（0，2）分，对10种疫苗核心知识点平均得分介于3.01~3.26分。多元线性回归分析显示，乡镇驻地研究对象的总体知晓得分比城市社区研究对象高0.066分（ P =0.012）；信任网络知名人士或名人博客者的总体知晓得分比信任接种单位工作人员者高0.512分（ P =0.007），信任网络、报纸等媒体官方报道、亲戚朋友介绍、医院医生建议和网络等媒体非官方报道者的总体知晓得分比信任接种单位工作人员者分别低0.180、0.466、0.255和0.353分（均 P P =0.045）；非医务工作者、离退休人员和其他职业者的总体核心知识点得分比医务工作者分别低0.209、0.254和0.269分（ P P =0.008、 P =0.001）；信任网络知名人士或名人博客者的总体核心知识点得分比信任接种单位工作人员者高0.936分（ P =0.017），信任网络、报纸等媒体官方报道、亲戚朋友介绍、医院医生建议和网络等媒体非官方报道者的总体核心知识点得分比信任接种单位工作人员者分别低0.213、0.675、0.415和0.586分（ P =0.004、 P P P =0.001）。态度方面，成人较为认同根据疾病严重程度选择接种儿童自费疫苗、尽量接种能够预防重要疾病的自费疫苗，并能接受接种后的轻微反应（3.57~3.73分）。但在减少自费疫苗接种、选择可替代免费疫苗的自费疫苗以及同时接种多种自费疫苗等问题上，仍存在顾虑或认识不足（2.76~3.03分）。 结论： 三省一市成人对非免疫规划疫苗的自评知晓程度较低，多数认可其预防价值，但部分仍对接种风险及多种疫苗同时接种存在顾虑。家庭居住地类型和获取信息的信任渠道与总体知晓得分相关；文化程度、职业和获取信息的信任渠道与总体核心知识点得分相关。.

items.title: [Analysis of the recommendation behaviors and influencing factors of vaccination staff towards adult non-national immunization program vaccines in three provinces and one municipality of China].
items.abstract: Objective: To analyze the recommendation behaviors and influencing factors of vaccination staff regarding non-National Immunization Program (non-NIP) vaccines for adults in Shandong Province, Anhui Province, Gansu Province and Shanghai City (hereinafter referred to as "three provinces and one municipality"), representing the eastern, central, and western regions of China. Methods: In November 2024, a multi-stage mixed sampling method was employed to select 404 staff members from 120 vaccination clinics across 30 counties (cities, districts) in three provinces and one municipality as study subjects for a questionnaire survey. Data were collected on their knowledge, attitudes, and current recommendation practices regarding six types of adult non-NIP vaccines, including the influenza vaccine, human papillomavirus vaccine, 23-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccine, hepatitis A vaccine, herpes zoster vaccine, and ACYW135 meningococcal polysaccharide vaccine. A multivariate logistic regression model was applied to identify factors associated with vaccine-related attitudes and vaccine recommendation behaviors. Results: Among 404 vaccination staff, males accounted for 9.90% (40). The median working years in immunization service was 13 (8, 22) years. The proportions of participants from Shandong, Anhui, Gansu Provinces and Shanghai Municipality were 27.97% (113), 26.98% (109), 36.14% (146), and 8.91% (36), respectively. Permanent staff accounted for 49.75% (201). The awareness rate, positive attitude rate, and recommended rate were 70.79% (286/404), 75.99% (307/404), and 50.50% (204/404), respectively. Logistic regression showed that staff with a bachelor's degree or higher achieved a higher positive rate ( OR =3.007, 95% CI : 1.201-7.528). Vaccination staff in Anhui Province ( OR =0.410, 95% CI : 0.176-0.955) and Gansu Province ( OR =0.199, 95% CI : 0.086-0.456) had lower positive rates of vaccine-related attitudes. Lower positive rates were also observed in staff with a monthly income of 4 000-5 999 yuan ( OR =0.469, 95% CI : 0.250-0.881) and those lacking awareness of vaccine-related information ( OR =0.531, 95% CI : 0.316-0.893). Regarding the three items,"It is one of the duties of immunization clinic staff to proactively introduce non-NIP vaccines to the public" ( OR =0.326, 95% CI : 0.156-0.683),"Given the risk of adverse reactions after vaccination, non-NIP vaccines should be administered as few as possible" ( OR =0.550, 95% CI : 0.311-0.975), and "The risk of adverse events will not increase when two or more non-NIP vaccines are administered simultaneously" ( OR =0.419, 95% CI : 0.268-0.655), participants with negative attitudes had lower recommendation rates for adult non-NIP vaccines than those with positive attitudes. Conclusion: The knowledge and attitudes regarding adult non-NIP vaccines among vaccination staff are acceptable, but the recommendation rate is lower. Vaccination staff with negative attitudes have lower recommendation rates for adult non-NIP vaccination. 目的： 分析我国山东省、安徽省、甘肃省、上海市（以下简称“三省一市”）预防接种门诊工作人员对成年人接种非免疫规划（non-NIP）疫苗推荐行为及相关因素。 方法： 于2024年11月选取三省一市30个县（市、区）120所预防接种门诊的404名工作人员为研究对象，通过问卷收集其对流感疫苗、人乳头瘤病毒疫苗、23价肺炎球菌多糖疫苗、甲型病毒性肝炎疫苗、带状疱疹疫苗、ACYW135群脑膜炎球菌多糖疫苗在内的6种成人non-NIP疫苗的知识、态度、推荐行为现状；采用多因素logistic回归模型分析疫苗相关态度和疫苗推荐行为的相关因素。 结果： 404名对象中，男性占9.90%（40名）；预防接种工龄 M （ Q 1 ， Q 3 ）为13（8，22）年；山东、安徽、甘肃省和上海市分别占27.97%（113名）、26.98%（109名）、36.14%（146名）、8.91%（36名）；正式在编职工占49.75%（201名）；对成人non-NIP疫苗知识知晓率、态度积极率、推荐率分别为70.79%（286/404）、75.99%（307/404）、50.50%（204/404）。多因素logistic回归分析显示，与山东省相比，安徽省（ OR =0.410，95% CI ：0.176~0.955）、甘肃省（ OR =0.199，95% CI ：0.086~0.456）工作人员疫苗相关态度积极率较低；与中专及以下学历相比，本科及以上学历者积极率较高（ OR =3.007，95% CI ：1.201~7.528）；与月收入 OR =0.469，95% CI ：0.250~0.881）；与疫苗知识知晓者相比，不知晓者积极率较低（ OR =0.531，95% CI ：0.316~0.893）。针对“向群众主动介绍非免疫规划疫苗是接种门诊工作人员的职责之一”“因为接种疫苗存在一定接种反应风险，所以非免疫规划疫苗尽可能少接种”“同时接种2种及以上非免疫规划疫苗，接种后不良反应事件风险不会增高”3个条目，与态度积极者相比，态度消极者对成人non-NIP疫苗推荐率更低， OR （95% CI ）分别为0.326（0.156~0.683）、0.550（0.311~0.975）、0.419（0.268~0.655）。 结论： 预防接种门诊工作人员对成人non-NIP疫苗认知水平尚可；但推荐率较低，疫苗相关态度消极者对成人non-NIP疫苗推荐率更低。.

items.title: [Cost-benefit analysis of antiviral treatment initiated for reported existing hepatitis C cases in Henan Province, 2022-2025].
items.abstract: Objective: To evaluate the health economic value of standardized treatment for existing hepatitis C virus (HCV) cases in Henan Province who initiated treatment between 2022 and 2025, and to compare the cost-benefit profiles of the genotype 1b-specific regimen and the pan-genotypic regimen. Methods: The existing cases with definite treatment regimens in the Henan Provincial Historical Card Database were selected as study objects. A total of 39 757 existing hepatitis C cases treated with direct-acting antiviral agents (DAAs) from 2022 to 2025 were enrolled, including 9 809 patients treated with genotype 1b-specific DAA and 29 948 treated with pan-genotypic DAA. A decision tree-Markov model with six health states was constructed in TreeAge Pro 2022, using a 1-year cycle and a lifetime horizon. Costs and benefits were estimated from a societal perspective at a 5% discount rate, with analyses stratified by regimen. Results: A total of 39 701 cases were cured, with an overall cure rate of 99.86%. The cumulative investment of 358 million yuan averted 7 941 cases of cirrhosis and 794 cases of liver cancer, generating a total benefit of 595 million yuan and yielding a benefit-cost ratio (BCR) of 1.66. In addition, 127 048 disability-adjusted life-years (DALYs) were averted at 2 821 yuan each, which was only 4.35% of Henan Province's 2024 per capita gross domestic product. By subgroup, the per-case cost of the 1b-specific regimen was only 52.9% of that of the pan-genotypic regimen, with a markedly superior BCR (2.77 vs . 1.47) and a lower cost per DALY averted (1 689 yuan vs . 3 192 yuan). Conclusion: Standardized treatment of reported prevalent HCV cases in Henan Province yields 1.66 yuan of benefit per yuan invested, with the genotype 1b-specific regimen being more cost-effective. 目的： 评价河南省已报告现存丙型肝炎（丙肝）病例于2022—2025年启动规范化治疗的卫生经济学价值，并比较按治疗方案分组（基因1b型特异性方案和泛基因型方案）的成本-效益差异。 方法： 以河南省历史卡片数据库中有明确治疗方案的现存病例为研究对象，共纳入2022—2025年采用直接抗病毒药物（DAA）治疗的39 757例现存丙肝病例，其中采用基因1b型特异性DAA者9 809例、泛基因型DAA者29 948例。运用TreeAge Pro 2022构建含6个健康状态的决策树-马尔科夫模型，循环周期1年、模拟时限终身，从全社会角度核算成本与效益，贴现率取5%，并按治疗方案分组测算。 结果： 2组合计治愈39 701例，总治愈率99.86%，累计投入3.58亿元，可避免肝硬化7 941例、肝癌794例；产生总效益5.95亿元，效益成本比（BCR）为1.66，挽回伤残调整生命年（DALY）12.7万人年，每挽回1个DALY的成本为2 821元，仅相当于2024年河南省人均国内生产总值的4.35%。分组分析显示，1b型组单例成本仅为泛基因型组的52.9%，其BCR达2.77、每挽回1个DALY成本1 689元，均优于泛基因型组（1.47、3 192元）。 结论： 河南省丙肝已报告现存病例规范化治疗每投入1元可产生1.66元经济效益，其中基因1b型特异性方案的经济性更优。.

items.title: Ampelopsis grossedentata restores the homeostasis of Th17/Treg cells to mitigate DSS-induced ulcerative colitis through TLR1-2/NF-κB signaling pathway.
items.abstract: Ampelopsis grossedentata (AG), a traditional medicine from Southwest China, is frequently used to treat inflammation, anemopyretic cold, pharyngitis, hepatitis, and dysentery. Pharmacological studies confirmed that primary active constituents of AG, including flavonoids, profoundly affect anti-inflammatory processes and immunomodulation. However, the therapeutic effect and mechanisms of AG for ulcerative colitis (UC) are still unclear. This study aimed to elucidate the mechanisms of AG treatment of UC. UPLC-MS and network pharmacology were employed to identify the active components of AG and their potential anti-UC mechanisms. A 4% dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced UC mouse model was established for assessing therapeutic efficacy of AG based on body weight, disease activity index, colon length, and histopathology of colon tissue. RT-qPCR, immunofluorescence assays and D-lactate levels were used to evaluate the inflammatory state and epithelial barrier integrity. Transcriptomic, proteomic, and flow cytometry analyses were performed to examine the underlying mechanisms. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), western blot and the TLR1/2 knockdown assays were used to identify and verify candidate targets. Five flavonoids in AG were characterized via UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS, with dihydromyricetin, taxifolin, myricitrin, and myricetin quantified by HPLC-DAD. Network pharmacology revealed 38 UC-related targets, enriched in IL-17/TNF signaling pathways. In vivo, AG alleviated UC-related symptoms, improved colon pathology, reduced the levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, TNF-α, IL-6), upregulated tight junction proteins (ZO-1, claudin 5), and inhibited the nuclear translocation of NF-κB (P65 and P50). Transcriptomic, proteomic, and flow cytometry analyses indicated that AG regulated Th17/Treg balance via the NF-κB signaling pathway. Structure-based molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, CETSA western blot and the TLR1/2 knockdown assays revealed that AG may act through the TLR1-TLR2 heterodimer receptor. AG effectively attenuates DSS-induced UC, potentially by restoring Th17/Treg balance and inhibiting NF-κB signaling through the TLR1-TLR2 heterodimer. AG is thus a therapeutic candidate for UC treatment.

items.title: Inverted U-Shaped Association between Hepatitis B Core-Related Antigen Levels and Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk.
items.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a major global cause of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Antiviral therapy suppresses hepatitis B virus DNA replication but does not eliminate intrahepatic covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA). Hepatitis B core-related antigen (HBcrAg) reflects cccDNA transcription and may serve as a biomarker. This study investigated whether baseline HBcrAg levels can predict HCC development. This study included 204 CHB patients receiving antiviral therapy and followed them for HCC development. Baseline HBcrAg levels were measured using a chemiluminescence immunoassay. The patients were categorized into tertiles on the basis of their HBcrAg levels: low (<5.17 log U/mL), moderate (5.17 to <6.87 log U/mL), and high (≥6.87 log U/mL). HCC was diagnosed in 24 patients. The 5-year cumulative incidence of HCC was 8.4% in the low HBcrAg group, 20.2% in the moderate group, and 3.2% in the high group (log-rank p<0.001). Multivariable Cox regression including sex, age, liver cirrhosis, platelet count, total bilirubin levels, albumin levels, creatinine levels, Fibrosis-4 Index, hepatitis B e antigen positivity, hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) levels, and HBcrAg levels showed that higher total bilirubin and moderate HBcrAg levels were associated with an increased risk of HCC. In contrast, higher HBsAg levels were associated with lower HCC risk. Patients with moderate pretreatment HBcrAg levels exhibited the highest HCC incidence despite antiviral therapy. Thus, pretreatment HBcrAg levels may serve as a potential biomarker for predicting long-term HCC risk.

items.title: [Screening, diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of hepatitis C virus-related liver disease].
items.abstract: Hepatitis C viral (HCV) infection has become curable. Eradication of the virus is essential from individual as well as from social aspects. Treatment in Hungary is based on a national consensus guideline, updated six-monthly. If there is no contraindication, demonstration of viral replication is the indication of therapy. Only direct-acting antiviral therapies are to be applied. At the time of publication of this guideline, only pan-genotypic combinations are available in Hungary. Based on fibrosis stage and on other (clinical, epidemiological, occupational, etc.) factors, a treatment prioritization system is available - however, all diagnosed infected individuals have access to reimbursed therapy nowadays. All infected individuals should be diagnosed and treated in a timely manner. Orv Hetil. 2026; 167(46): 1847-1861. A hepatitis C-vírus (HCV)-fertőzés napjainkra gyógyíthatóvá vált. A fertőzöttség megszüntetése egyéni és társadalmi szempontból egyaránt előnyös és szükséges. A kezelés hazánkban a rendelkezésre álló gyógyszereken és finanszírozási lehetőségeken alapuló, félévenként megújított konszenzusajánlás szerint történik. Ellenjavallat hiányában a kezelés indikációja a vírusszaporodás kimutatása. A kezelés a HCV elleni direkt antivirális kombinációk valamelyikével végzendő. Az ajánlás közzétételének idejében hazánkban kizárólag a valamennyi genotípus esetében hatékony (pángenotípus) kombinált készítmények állnak rendelkezésre. A kezelésbe vonás sorrendjének meghatározására a fibrosis stádiumán és egyéb (klinikai, epidemiológiai, foglalkozás-egészségügyi stb.) szempontokon alapuló prioritási pontrendszer áll rendelkezésre – de napjainkban minden diagnosztizált beteg számára közfinanszírozott készítmények érhetők el. Valamennyi fertőzött mielőbbi kivizsgálása és kezelésbe vonása indokolt. Orv Hetil. 2026; 167(46): 1847–1861.

items.title: Exhaled Breath Condensate-Derived Extracellular Vesicles Isolated via Nanobody-SpyTag3 Fusion Proteins Enable Lung Cancer Diagnosis.
items.abstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) carry molecular fingerprints of their parent cells, making them attractive liquid biopsy targets. Specific and efficient isolation and retrieval of intact EVs enable comprehensive analysis of EV cargo; however, current approaches remain suboptimal. Here, anti-CD9 nanobody-SpyTag3 fusion proteins were developed to immunoisolate EVs from exhaled breath condensate (EBC) for DNA mutation analysis in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Within 2 h, this assay achieves 94% and 47% EV enrichment from biomimetic EBC and plasma, respectively, outperforming traditional physical methods. Subsequent restriction enzyme treatment recovers 95% of intact EVs within 2 h. Pilot clinical data suggest that EBC EVs may be better suited for early-stage central-type NSCLC, whereas plasma EVs may perform better in advanced peripheral-type cases. In summary, we present a new tool for EV-based diagnosis, highlight the potential of EBC EVs for noninvasive lung cancer detection, and demonstrate the impact of biofluid selection on diagnostic performance.

items.title: QSG-7701 is not a Normal hepatocyte line: Reassessing the claimed selectivity of mitochondria-targeted podophyllotoxin derivatives.
items.abstract: This communication addresses a critical interpretation issue in a recent study on mitochondria-targeted podophyllotoxin derivatives for liver cancer therapy. The authors used QSG-7701 as a normal hepatocyte comparator to calculate selectivity indices, although QSG-7701 has been reported to be HeLa-derived. HepG2, the principal liver tumor cell model examined, is hepatoblastoma-derived rather than hepatocellular carcinoma-derived. For compound 6d, the reported ratio of 2.29 therefore represents a modest difference in potency between two tumor-derived cell lines, not selectivity for liver tumor cells over normal hepatocytes. This misclassification undermines conclusions concerning reduced normal hepatocyte toxicity and a therapeutic window, without necessarily invalidating the reported antiproliferative, mitochondrial colocalization, or apoptosis findings. Assessment of normal hepatocyte sparing requires authenticated and appropriately validated non-malignant human liver models.

items.title: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases in hepatic metabolism and hepatocellular carcinoma: Current status and future perspectives on subcellular localization.
items.abstract: UDP-glucuronosyltransferases (UGTs) are essential phase II metabolic enzymes that catalyze the glucuronidation of both xenobiotics and critical endogenous metabolites, including bilirubin, bile acids, steroid hormones, and bioactive lipid mediators, thereby maintaining systemic and hepatic metabolic homeostasis. Dysregulated UGT expression and impaired glucuronidation capacity are widely documented in liver diseases and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Beyond canonical endoplasmic reticulum (ER) localization, accumulating biochemical and immunological evidence suggests that selected UGT isoforms may also reside in noncanonical membrane-associated compartments, such as the nuclear envelope and plasma membrane, under specific cellular contexts. In this review, we comprehensively summarize the genomic architecture, isoform-specific functional diversification, and molecular regulation of the human UGT superfamily, while presenting updated quantitative kinetics for major endogenous substrates. We further critically evaluate the experimental evidence for canonical and extra-ER UGT localization, addressing fundamental topological constraints, cofactor (UDP-glucuronic acid) transport, and organelle-specific catalytic feasibility. Finally, we synthesize current quantitative transcriptomic, proteomic, and functional findings on UGT dysregulation in HCC, while delineating established clinical observations from hypothetical models regarding whether organellar redistribution influences cancer-associated metabolic reprogramming. Overall, this review provides a balanced, evidence-based synthesis of UGT spatial biology and outlines decisive research avenues for clarifying the role of compartmentalized glucuronidation in hepatic health and malignancy.

items.title: Cancer-Associated Fibroblast-Derived miR-483-5p Promotes Liver Cancer Cell Proliferation and Stemness via MOAP1 Downregulation.
items.abstract: Within the tumor microenvironment (TME), cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) play an important role in liver cancer progression through intercellular communication, including the release of small extracellular vesicles (sEVs). This study investigated the potential mechanisms underlying the effects of CAF-associated miR-483-5p on liver cancer progression. sEV-enriched preparations were isolated from CAFs transfected with a miR-483-5p mimic or an antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) and subsequently used to treat HepG2 cells. These preparations were designated as CAF-sEV-miR-483-5p-mimic and CAF-sEV-miR-483-5p-ASO, respectively. To evaluate cell proliferation and stemness, colony formation and spheroid formation assays were applied. Additionally, a subcutaneous xenograft model in nude mice was established to assess the in vivo effects of these CAF-derived sEV-enriched preparations. MiR-483-5p enhanced HepG2 cell proliferation, stemness, and migration, and higher miR-483-5p expression was associated with poorer patient prognosis. CAF-derived sEV-enriched preparations was associated with increased miR-483-5p levels in HepG2 cells, suggesting that these preparations may contribute to the regulation of miR-483-5p levels in recipient cells. The CAF-sEV-miR-483-5p mimic preparation promoted HepG2 cell proliferation and stemness while suppressing apoptosis. Luciferase reporter and reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) assays supported the direct interaction between miR-483-5p and the Modulator of apoptosis 1 (MOAP1) 3' untranslated region (3'-UTR) and showed that miR-483-5p negatively regulates MOAP1 expression. MOAP1 downregulation was associated with increased proliferation and stemness in HepG2 cells. Importantly, MOAP1 overexpression attenuated miR-483-5p-induced increases in proliferation, migration, and stemness in HepG2 cells, as well as the upregulation of Wnt1, β-catenin, Nanog, Sox2, and Oct4. Furthermore, miR-483-5p ASO reversed the effects of CAF-derived sEV-enriched preparations on miR-483-5p levels, MOAP1 expression, and HepG2 cell viability. In vivo, the CAF-sEV-miR-483-5p-mimic preparation promoted xenograft tumor growth in nude mice. Collectively, CAF-derived sEV-enriched preparations may contribute to increased miR-483-5p levels and promote the growth and stemness of liver cancer cells, potentially through miR-483-5p-mediated downregulation of MOAP1. These findings suggest that the miR-483-5p/MOAP1 regulatory axis may serve as a potential therapeutic target for liver cancer.
